intermediate: For each original component, its enclosed-cell set and total enclosed area; disconnected components of the same color remain separate records.
step_a: Discover each four-connected same-color component, flood its component-only bounding box from boundary zeros, and count all remaining enclosed cells.
step_b: Select every positive-area component tied for the largest or smallest total enclosed area, then paint exactly its enclosed cells with its own color.
why_b_depends_on_a: The selected object set depends on areas discovered by the flood fill. In the retained tied-extrema scene, replacing those areas with wall-cell counts changes the selected objects although their computed hole masks, colors, and paint operation stay unchanged.
